# Who misses compliance training

The same two volunteers missed compliance training again. One works Saturdays, the other cannot leave her father alone. Repeating the session on the same timetable isn't offering another chance. Jo will try paired practice during an ordinary shift. We can record which tasks were demonstrated without publishing a list of supposedly unreliable people. [[Volunteer handbook]] should say where help is available.
